keyEvents.text: Goal! Manchester City 0, Brighton and Hove Albion 1. Yasin Ayari (Brighton and Hove Albion) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Maxim De Cuyper following a set piece situation.
Chema Andrés (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Manchester City 0, Brighton and Hove Albion 1.
Second Half begins Manchester City 0, Brighton and Hove Albion 1.
Delay in match because of an injury Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Manchester City. Rayan Cherki replaces Ayyoub Bouaddi.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Jaouen Hadjam replaces Olivier Boscagli.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Mats Wieffer replaces Chema Andrés.
Substitution, Manchester City. Nico O'Reilly replaces Enzo Fernández.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Malick Yalcouyé replaces Maxim De Cuyper.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Jack Hinshelwood replaces Charalampos Kostoulas.
Substitution, Manchester City. Allan replaces Iliman Ndiaye.
Substitution, Manchester City. Phil Foden replaces Josko Gvardiol.
Pascal Groß (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Georginio Rutter replaces Diego Gómez.
